revision.reason: After a preliminary 54-case run, independent design review found that the additive measurement-seed mapping collided across adjacent replicate seeds and different planes. Correct only the measurement-seed mapping; scientific matrix, normal feed errors, fault locations, algorithms, alpha grid and limits remain fixed. The preliminary run is retained and is not the final score.

scope: Independent virtual feed-error sensitivity experiment; equivalent radiating coefficients, no real measurement or port calibration claim

normal_feed_error_definition.phase_distribution: zero-mean Gaussian, configured standard deviation in degrees
normal_feed_error_definition.independence: independent amplitude and phase RNG streams; i.i.d. across elements
normal_feed_error_definition.noise_comparison: fixed relative SNR per state, not fixed absolute receiver noise

faults.positions: seeded random without replacement; shared across scenarios and frequencies

pairing.measurement_seed: replicate_seed*10 + 100000 + plane_index, where plane_index is training=0, validation=1, test=2; the registered three-seed set has nine unique measurement seeds
pairing.shared_noise: identical unit complex Gaussian per replicate and plane across scenarios, frequencies and healthy/faulted states, scaled by each clean field RMS to 40 dB

dense_prior: training-only least-squares common gain times ideal nominal vector; no true element errors
selection: independent noisy validation points; coefficient truth and injection labels enter scoring only; test points never select parameters

evaluation_gauges.coefficient_accuracy: evaluation-only scalar vdot(estimate,truth)/vdot(estimate,estimate).real, matching the original validation; relative accuracy, not absolute calibration
evaluation_gauges.anomaly_detection: median amplitude and circular phase of estimate/known ideal nominal, matching original robust nominal gauge; coefficient truth never sets the detection gauge

classification_reporting: Preserve old injected-fault metrics and unchanged thresholds. Healthy physical-fault precision/recall are null. Separately report truth-through-detector oracle and detection against true nominal-threshold deviations, because dense normal errors can cross the old thresholds.
field_reporting: All methods use the same independent test points and report clean and noisy relative field errors separately.
limitations: i.i.d. feed errors only; no unprovided chip correlation
scalar finite aperture truth against point-source inverse
only three paired replicates; no broad reliability claim
normal variation may be suppressed by sparse or nominal-centered priors
condition number is fixed per frequency and geometry, not new evidence for each excitation
